cohort: The study included 185 mothers and 34 paired singleton neonates from an immigrant population in New York, with data collected between 2007 and 2009.
finding: Fetal exposure to specific parabens (BuPB, PrPB) and triclocarban was associated with adverse birth outcomes including increased odds of preterm birth, decreased gestational age at birth, birth weight, and body length, though some parabens (BePB, 3'-Cl-TCC) showed protective effects.
